**Section 4: Communication Policy and Member Data Privacy**

Adopted by the Managing Committee on 12-11-2024, effective from 01-12-2024. This policy supersedes the earlier informal practice of circulating notices through the watchman and applies to all communication between the Society and its members, and among members.

**4.1 Official Channels of Communication**

The Society shall use the following official channels for all communication with members:

| Channel | Purpose | Frequency / Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Notice Board (Ground Floor, near lift lobby) | Statutory notices, AGM/EGM notices, election notices, water cut schedules, lift maintenance shutdowns | As required, minimum 7 days for meetings |
| Email (as registered with the Society) | Individual notices, payment reminders, circulars, committee minutes summary | As required; reminders sent on the 5th and 20th of each month |
| WhatsApp Group (official, admin-managed) | Urgent operational updates (e.g., power failure, water tanker arrival, security alerts) | Only for time-sensitive information; no general discussion |
| Society Website (members’ login) | Archived copies of all circulars, minutes, financial statements, and forms | Updated within 7 days of issue |

Members are requested to keep their email address and mobile number updated with the office. Any change must be intimated in writing or through the member portal at least 15 days in advance. The Society shall not be responsible for non-receipt of notices due to outdated contact details on record.

**4.2 Member Data Privacy**

The Society collects and maintains personal data of members for the sole purpose of administration, maintenance, and statutory compliance. The Managing Committee shall ensure that:

- Personal data (including but not limited to contact numbers, email addresses, employment details, and vehicle registration numbers) is not shared with any third party, commercial entity, or individual member without the prior written consent of the member concerned.
- Access to the member register is restricted to the Chairman, Secretary, Treasurer, and the office administrator. Any other person, including an MC member, may inspect the register only for a bonafide purpose and after recording their name, flat number, and reason for inspection in the Inspection Register maintained at the office.
- Copies of the register or extracts thereof shall not be made without the explicit approval of the MC. Requests for such copies shall be placed before the MC at its next meeting.
- All electronic records shall be password-protected, and the password shall be changed every quarter by the Secretary.
- Data retention: Records of members who have transferred their flat shall be retained for a period of 8 years from the date of transfer, after which the same shall be securely destroyed, except for statutory records required under the Maharashtra Cooperative Societies Act, 1960.

Members are advised that the Society does not sell, rent, or trade member data. Any member found to be using the Society’s directory for commercial or personal solicitation shall be liable to action under the Society’s Bye-laws.

**4.3 Grievance Redressal for Communication Issues**

If a member does not receive a notice or communication, they may raise the issue with the Secretary in writing within 15 days of the date of the communication. The Secretary shall verify the delivery record (e.g., email log, WhatsApp delivery status) and respond within 7 days. If the issue is not resolved, the member may place the matter before the MC at its next meeting.

**Entry No: 045**

**Section 4: Communication Policy and Member Data Privacy**

Adopted by the Managing Committee on 12-11-2024, effective from 01-12-2024. This policy supersedes the earlier informal practice of circulating notices through the watchman and applies to all communication between the Society and its members, and among members.

**4.1 Official Channels of Communication**

The Society shall use the following official channels for all communication with members:

| Channel | Purpose | Frequency / Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Notice Board (Ground Floor, near lift lobby) | Statutory notices, AGM/EGM notices, election notices, water cut schedules, lift maintenance shutdowns | As required, minimum 7 days for meetings |
| Email (as registered with the Society) | Individual notices, payment reminders, circulars, committee minutes summary | As required; reminders sent on the 5th and 20th of each month |
| WhatsApp Group (official, admin-managed) | Urgent operational updates (e.g., power failure, water tanker arrival, security alerts) | Only for time-sensitive information; no general discussion |
| Society Website (members’ login) | Archived copies of all circulars, minutes, financial statements, and forms | Updated within 7 days of issue |

Members are requested to keep their email address and mobile number updated with the office. Any change must be intimated in writing or through the member portal at least 15 days in advance. The Society shall not be responsible for non-receipt of notices due to outdated contact details on record.

**4.2 Member Data Privacy**

The Society collects and maintains personal data of members for the sole purpose of administration, maintenance, and statutory compliance. The Managing Committee shall ensure that:

- Personal data (including but not limited to contact numbers, email addresses, employment details, and vehicle registration numbers) is not shared with any third party, commercial entity, or individual member without the prior written consent of the member concerned.
- Access to the member register is restricted to the Chairman, Secretary, Treasurer, and the office administrator. Any other person, including an MC member, may inspect the register only for a bonafide purpose and after recording their name, flat number, and reason for inspection in the Inspection Register maintained at the office.
- Copies of the register or extracts thereof shall not be made without the explicit approval of the MC. Requests for such copies shall be placed before the MC at its next meeting.
- All electronic records shall be password-protected, and the password shall be changed every quarter by the Secretary.
- Data retention: Records of members who have transferred their flat shall be retained for a period of 8 years from the date of transfer, after which the same shall be securely destroyed, except for statutory records required under the Maharashtra Cooperative Societies Act, 1960.

Members are advised that the Society does not sell, rent, or trade member data. Any member found to be using the Society’s directory for commercial or personal solicitation shall be liable to action under the Society’s Bye-laws.

**4.3 Grievance Redressal for Communication Issues**

If a member does not receive a notice or communication, they may raise the issue with the Secretary in writing within 15 days of the date of the communication. The Secretary shall verify the delivery record (e.g., email log, WhatsApp delivery status) and respond within 7 days. If the issue is not resolved, the member may place the matter before the MC at its next meeting.
